newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Moldova to offer 330 million lei of T-bills in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Moldova to offer 330 million lei of T-bills in Q2.

text.p: Moldova plans to issue 330 million lei of Treasury bills in the second quarter of this year, the Finance Ministry said on Tuesday.
The time-table for the T-bills auctions for the second quarter stipulates that T-bills of five maturities -- 28, 91, 182, 273 and 364 days -- will be offered to investors once a week on Tuesdays.
The bulk of the issuance -- 237 million lei -- will be accounted for by 91-day notes.
The ministry will issue 26 million lei of 28-day bills, 24 million lei of 182-day bills, 18 million lei of 273-day bills and 25 million lei of 364-day bills.

At present the yield on Moldovan T-bills is fluctuating around 30 percent.
Moldova's annual inflation was 15.1 percent in 1996. This year the government is forecasting 13 percent inflation, while the National Bank is targeting 10 percent.
The Moldovan leu, is stable at 4.6-4.7 lei per $1.
Moldovan T-bills are sold by the National Bank through 18 primary banks-dealers, which buy the notes both for themselves and (foreign) clients.

These banks are: Universalbank, Moldova-Agroindbank, Banca Sociala, Mobiasbanca, Bancosind, Victoriabank, Oguzbank, Guinea, Petrolbank, Moldindconbank, Eximbank, Banca de Economii, Comertbank, Unibank, Vias, Banca de Finante si Comert, BIID-MB, Investprivatbank.
